name: Rule O
placementTarget: Rulebook slot O. No letter O and no card code are printed on the sticker.
text:
BUILD SATELLITE TOWER
Spend 2 Supply cubes from your Character
card to build a satellite tower in your city. If
there are no more available, move an existing
satellite tower to your city instead.

TRANSMIT
At a city containing a satellite tower, give
1 card matching the color of the city you are
in to another player. The other player may be
anywhere in the world.

mechanics.timing: Build Satellite Tower is an action in your city. Transmit is an action in a city that contains a satellite tower.
mechanics.effect: Build Satellite Tower: spend 2 Supply cubes from your Character card to build a satellite tower in your city. If no tower miniature is left, move an existing satellite tower to your city instead. Transmit: give 1 card matching the color of the city you are in to another player anywhere in the world.
restrictions: The cubes come from your Character card, not from the city or the supply reserve.
Moving an existing tower happens only when none of the 6 tower miniatures are available.
Transmit gives exactly 1 card, and that card must match the color of the city you are in, not merely a card you choose.
The player reference strips are shorter than this rule. This sticker is the full rule.
